nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: 24/7. A 31-day month is 744 instance-hours against the 750 a free Render workspace gets, so always-on fits with about six hours to spare, and the allowance resets on the 1st rather than on a rolling window. The margin is thin and the 750 is shared across every free web service in the workspace, so adding a second one would exceed it -- Render then suspends all of them until the next month. Static sites do not count. Five minutes leaves room for two missed runs inside the 15-minute idle timeout.

nodes.name: Ping Health Endpoint
nodes.notes: /health rather than /actuator/health. This path touches nothing, so it wakes the web service without also waking the Neon database and spending its compute hours. 90s timeout because a cold JVM start is 40-60s and a shorter one aborts before the wake completes.
